name: calc_sharpe_ratio
description:
Sharpe ratio: (portfolio return - risk-free rate) / volatility. Computed locally in Python; no API key or network.
Returns {sharpe_ratio}, 4 decimals; 0 when volatility is 0.
Inputs (* required): portfolio_return*, risk_free_rate*, volatility* (all percent over the same period, e.g. annual).
To penalise only downside risk use calc_sortino_ratio.
Example: {"portfolio_return": 12, "risk_free_rate": 4, "volatility": 15}
